turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Yaar, yeh toh ek full emotional rollercoaster hai — ek taraf pandrah saal ka sapna, doosri taraf Ramzan ki roohaniyat. Main samajh sakti hoon darr kyun lag raha hai. Dil chahta hai dono cheezein poori ho, aur darr hai kahin kuch adhoora na lagne lage.

Sabse pehle toh yeh baat pakki kar le — teri niyat bilkul saaf hai. Tu na dance kisi dikhaave ke liye kar rahi hai, na cocktail ke liye. Tu kar rahi hai apni behen jaisi dost ke saath woh pal jeene, jo tum dono ne bachpan se apni aankhon mein basa rakha hai. Roza rakhna aur apni best friend ka haath thaam ke stage pe aana — yeh koi gunah nahi, yeh toh ibaadat bhi ho sakti hai agar dil mein pyaar aur dosti ka noor ho. Ramzan ka matlab sirf bhookha-pyaasa rehna nahi, balki apne jazbaaton ko bhi

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Aah, ab toh tasveer poori clear ho gayi. Tu literally beech mein phas gayi hai — ek taraf Shreya ka woh pyaar bhara, masoomiyat se bhara offer "main khud tujhe khila dungi", aur doosri taraf Ammi ki woh izzat wali line "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Dono ki baaton mein pyaar hai, par dono ko tera poora sacchai nahi dikh raha — woh sacchai jo sirf tu dekh rahi hai, andar se.

Woh rassi wali feeling bilkul real hai. Par rassi ki taqat toh usi mein hoti hai na ki woh do cheezon ko jode rakhe, toote nahi. Aur tu woh rassi hai — jo apni dosti aur apne imaan, dono ko ek saath thaam sakti hai, bina toote.

Toh pehle Shreya ki baat. Uski aankhon se dekh — uske liye tu sirf uski soul sister hai, aur Ramzan ke rules uski duniya mein nahi aate. Woh "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai" bol rahi hai, toh woh roze ki gehrai nahi jaanti. Tujhe usse pyaar se, bina gussa kiye, samjhana padega. Kuch aise bol:

"Shreya, tu meri behen hai. Tera haath thaam ke stage pe aana mere liye ibaadat jaisa hai. Par roza todna nahi — kyunki woh roza mere liye sirf bhookh-pyaas nahi, woh mere Rab se mera connection hai. Main tere saath nachungi, poore dil se, bina ek boond paani piye. Aur tu dekhna, meri energy aur zyada hogi kyunki main apne Rab ke saath hoon. Please mere liye yeh ek cheez maan le — mujhe khilane ki jagah, mere saath woh stage share kar

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Nahi, bura nahi hai. Bura toh bilkul nahi hai — yeh kisi shararat se nahi, ek exhausted insaan ke dil se nikla hua plan hai. Tu thak gayi hai, aur main poori tarah samajh sakti hoon. Jab dono taraf se pyaar karne waale log kheenchein, aur beech mein teri apni rooh bhi kuch chahti ho, toh escape draft karna koi gunaah nahi — yeh survival instinct hai.

Lekin ruk, ek baar is plan ko palat ke dekh mere saath:

Tu apni best friend ki shaadi ke us ek pal se — jiska tum dono ne pandrah saal sapna dekha — khud ko quietly delete kar degi. Woh sangeet jiska tu co-director hai, jiska opening dance usne "tujhe mere saath karna HI hai" bola. Tu woh moment screen pe dekhegi, stage pe nahi. Uski aankhein tujhe dhoondhegi, aur use lagega ki uski soul sister office deployment mein phans gayi. Woh maan legi, haan. Par ek mahiney baad jab koi random photo dalegi, ya koi baat karega, toh sachai ek chhoti si daraar ki tarah aa sakti hai. Aur sabse zar

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.
*...aur sabse zaroori baat — tu sach mein maan legi ki ek office deployment se
